scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Personal tokens or registered apps; organization approval/SSO may restrict customer resources.
app.surface: REST + GraphQL; repos, issues, PRs, actions and administration
app.note: Prefer a least-privilege GitHub App for multi-tenant automation; personal tokens suit prototypes.
app.workflow: Read a public repository, then scoped issues
app.next_action: Use the existing public-repository demo as a smoke test, then authorize a least-privilege GitHub App to read issues in one test repository.
app.success_criterion: Keep the public HTTP-200 result separate from a new authenticated issue-read test and record granted repository permissions.
app.alternative_action: Compare official MCP issue tools with required fields and installation boundaries before adding custom REST tools.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
